name: Interlocking: RBC/RBC link lost before the handover
description: Like the handover run, without the freight train ahead, but the link between RBC 1 and RBC 2 is lost at 200 s for 300 s. Without the route related information of RBC 2, RBC 1 gives an authority only up to the border: the train stops before it and continues when the link is back, the handover then runs as usual.
